title: Squirt gun
abstract: A toy squirt gun that shoots a continuous high velocity stream of water using compressed air pressurization. The gun features a manually actuated air pump mounted under the barrel, a trigger-controlled flow valve, and dual sound effects—one from a battery-powered oscillator circuit and another from a water-flow-powered sound generator that produces pulsating tones through vibrating reeds.
gist: The original pressurized water gun by Lonnie Johnson, the NASA engineer behind the Super Soaker. A hand pump pressurizes air over the water reservoir; pulling the trigger opens a valve and fires a continuous high-velocity stream, far outperforming squeeze-trigger squirt guns.
